profile: Mixed chat/workflow load: concurrent chat posts, streams and media against durable workflow timer and admission traffic, compared to a workflow-only baseline captured in the same run.

source_evidence.claim: The routing contract requires mixed-load measurement, workflow-only comparison and a measured regression budget before broad activation.
The proposed workflow-isolation-under-mixed-load SLO sets a candidate <=5% regression budget and a workflow wake-up p95 <=5 second ceiling, both requiring Operations/workflow-owner approval.
Suite planning objectives include p99 <1 s local authoritative commit and workflow wake-up p95 <=5 s; these are the reference values this gate's ceilings borrow.

A local mixed-load profile records core-operation-store p95/p99 latency before, during and while the chat send lane is saturated, plus admitted chat send latency; it is a regression probe, not this signed gate.

required_roles: Messaging Platform engineering and operations owner
